description: The hermitage consumed by wildfire. Dhritarashtra, Gandhari, and Kunti refuse to flee. They die in the flames — a final act of tapasya (austerity). Ashramvasika Parva — The Forest Fire. Purification through fire.

interactive_elements: Three figures sitting calmly in meditation as fire approaches
vn_backdrop_notes.note: The last of the old generation departs. The cycle closes.
